J_easy_label: post-hoc common score J_E = L_E + beta*S_E; the easy formulation minimises L only
hard_objective_label: min alpha*L + beta*S (the hard formulation's own objective)
integrator_note: the hard OPTIMISER integrates J with the trapezoid rule on 400 spline samples (the same active grid as the collocation constraints); the reported L, S and J of both routes are recalculated afterwards by the same polyline evaluator (segment sums, midpoint field values)
